evals.prompt: Create an editable three-slide board update: decision requested, performance, and next steps. Performance data: Q1 72%, Q2 81%, Q3 88% on-time delivery. Use a native editable chart with a 0–100% axis and add speaker notes explaining the metric. Render and inspect all slides if tools permit.
evals.expected_output: A three-slide PPTX with editable text and chart, accurate values and visible labels, notes, and honest visual QA evidence.
assertions: The PPTX contains exactly three slides.
A native chart contains 72, 81, 88 (or consistently scaled fractions) and correctly formatted percentage labels.
The chart axis and the data scale agree.
Every slide was visually inspected or the answer explicitly identifies the unverified check.

evals.prompt: Update the attached investor-update.pptx: replace the ARR figure on slide 2 with USD 1.4 million and update its speaker note. Preserve slide order, masters, existing chart workbooks, hyperlinks, and the other slides. Save a new file and show what was checked.
evals.expected_output: A focused editable update retaining the source structure and unmodified content, with preservation checks and any unsupported feature limitation.
evals.fixture_contract: Provide an original deck with at least four slides, custom layout, native chart workbook, slide-2 ARR figure and note, and a hyperlink.
assertions: Only the requested ARR content and note change semantically.
Chart workbook, hyperlink targets and master/layout relationships remain present.
No whole-slide rasterization replaces editable content.

evals.prompt: Repair the attached training-deck.pptx. Slide 1 has a long paragraph clipped inside a box; slide 2 has a rotated label outside the slide; slide 3 has overlapping table and footer. Keep all facts and editable content. Do not just shrink everything. Render and inspect every slide.
evals.expected_output: A repaired editable deck, or an honest visual-tool blocker; no claim that the bounding-box script alone found every defect.
evals.fixture_contract: Provide a three-slide original deck with the stated internal overflow, rotated extents, and overlap defects.
assertions: All original facts remain in slides or appropriate speaker notes.
The answer recognizes that top-level geometry checks cannot certify text fit or overlap.
Rendered images are actually viewed before claiming visual repairs are verified.
The output remains editable and does not solve all overflow by unreadable text shrinking.
